svg.title: Local-First Architecture & Hardened Compilation Boundary
svg.desc: Three-tier horizontal NovaTeX architecture: Tier 1 Clients (Local Web Studio and Local AI Agents via novatex-sync CLI), Tier 2 Single-Port NovaTeX Server (Express HTTP + Local Workspace, Local SQLite WAL + Native Git, AES-256-GCM BYOK AI with Public-Only SSRF and DNS guard, Format Hub and Lab Toolkit), crossing a hardened compilation boundary into Tier 3 Hardened TeX Sandbox (Local Embedded Sandbox or Optional Remote Worker with HMAC-SHA256 replay protection and strict TeX confinement).
